jobs.title: Solar Field Technician - Los Angeles
jobs.description:
About QE Solar

QE Solar is one of the nation's largest independent solar and BESS operations and maintenance providers, with over 15 years of operating experience. We manage 10 GW of solar and 7.5 GWh of BESS across 44 states, supporting asset owners with multi-hundred MW utility solar projects and large standalone BESS systems. We're pure-play O&M. That focus means our entire organization is built around one thing: keeping solar and storage assets running well. Our technicians carry broad OEM certifications, and our in-house capabilities span MV/HV electrical, vegetation management, engineering, and capital improvements, to streamline asset management for project owners.

About The Role

As a Solar Field Technician at QE Solar, you are responsible for providing ongoing field services support to multiple solar, battery storage (BESS) or other renewable energy systems on a continual/on-demand basis in order to optimize equipment performance, troubleshoot/resolve equipment issues, support emergency repairs and other provide ongoing O&M compliance support. In this role you will assist with all routine site inspections, maintenance projects, equipment & system testing, and other project compliance, troubleshoot or restoration matters. Field Service Technicians regularly participate in field support, training and project safety orientations/classes in order to develop skills and technical expertise in one or multiple disciplines including PV array, inverter, medium voltage, BESS and other solar services. Operations Leads, Solar Engineers and other management will provide regular coaching and training and will qualify technicians for field operations.

Essential Duties

Diagnose and repair systems failures as existing solar sites, identify and correct potential issues that may impact site performance in the future. Assist and support field teams with real-time solutions to site operations issues and execute the same. Diagnose/troubleshoot equipment failures and perform regular preventative maintenance on a variety of solar, BESS and other project equipment. Support field teams and clients via oversight/support of warranty matters regarding equipment and systems for use or replacement. Installs, removes, troubleshoots and the maintenance of solar, BESS and other related electrical equipment.
Ensure a safe, event-free work environment through strict adherence to company and client protocols, safety procedures and regulations. Ensure compliance with all safety requirements and safe best practices (e.g. lock-out/tag-out compliance, JHA completion, LDL testing, and compliance with all company safety policies or procedures and work practices).
Prepare service tickets and reports for site visits, emergency repairs, equipment modifications and equipment improvement investigations. Provide reports, written and oral communication in a timely and complete fashion.
Communicate with technical leads, project leads/managers, and third-party sub-contractors to ensure timely resolution to all required activities; Support recommended performance improvements and at address site safety and compliance concerns; Other responsibilities as directed by manager.

Education Required

High School or Technical School Degree, Or, equivalent combination of education and experience; Veterans or military experienced candidates are strongly encouraged to apply

Experience Required

0-2+ years of specialist, technical experience with solar projects, BESS, or other renewable systems; Experience with data acquisition systems.

Experience Preferred

Experience working with 600v-1500v systems; Strong knowledge of NEC, IEEE and current NFPA-70e requirements; Proficient with technology and computing programs/platforms; C&I/Utility Scale solar work experience; Experience with operations of solar sites and/or project maintenance and compliance.

Specialized Or Technical Knowledge Licenses, Certifications Preferred

Inverter and/or BESS manufacturers’ certifications (e.g SunGrow, Power Electronics, Solectria, BYD, etc) a plus
Thermography certifications (Level 1)
IT/networking skills: Familiarity with RS485, Modbus, tcp/ip, etc.
NABCEP PV Installer Certification
Minimum OSHA 10/30 Certification
Completion of NFPA 70E courses
CPR/First Aid

Physical Requirements

Ability to lift 25/50/80 pounds regularly.
Ability to move safely over uneven terrain.
Ability to sit or drive for prolonged periods.
Ability to safely climb ladders while carrying 50 pound.
Ability to work in extreme weather.

Travel Requirements

Extensive travel regionally and occasionally nationally, to meet client field operation’s needs.

QE Solar offers incredible benefits! We enjoy:

100% paid employee premium on health benefits; additional dependents at low costs and great plans for Health, Dental, Vision, FSA or HSA
Wellbeing and Employee Assistance
Learning & Development Opportunities
Discounted Life & Disability Insurance

Please note: Employees that are subject to hire are often assigned to isolated facilities where you will operate without direct supervision and interact with other employees and clients in secluded settings. Given this, it is crucial to ensure that there is no propensity for property or violent crimes, which could pose a significant risk to the safety of our employees, clients, and the general public. These positions are also subject to mandatory background checks as required by federal law for access to certain locations. We encourage and welcome all to apply regardless of this disclaimer.

QE Solar accepts resumes only from contracted recruiting agencies with formal service agreements. Please do not send unsolicited resumes or outreach emails to our QE Solar employees, hiring managers, or team members without expressed consent or contract for services. QE Solar is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes or services.

25 - 35 USD per hour (Los Angeles, CA)

The Opportunity

Tetra Tech is adding a GIS Analyst to our GIS team based in Buffalo, NY.

Why Tetra Tech

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Position Summary

Tetra Tech is currently seeking a motivated, articulate and dynamic, middle to senior level GIS Analyst to support our natural resources projects and programs. The successful candidate will have experience with GIS, cloud infrastructure, and computer science experience. They should be comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, supporting multiple projects in a team setting. A willingness to learn existing systems, templates, and workflows as well as improve these processes. This individual will be detail oriented and will be asked to manage extremely large datasets within the confines of stringent agreements with clients.

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting a variety of natural resources projects, with a primary focus on GIS analysis/mapping, GIS data management in a cloud system, and produce technical reports. The candidate will generally support senior-level staff with GIS analysis/mapping, report writing, and technical support.

Essential Job Functions

Candidate will be required to act as a GIS analyst for projects with an ecological services component and other duties as assigned. The successful candidate with appropriate work ethic for the industry and position will assist with environmental surveys, reporting, and permitting processes. Additionally, as required by the supervisor, the successful candidate will work overtime and/or weekends. Essential duties include the following:

Take complex ideas, convert them to User Experiences and visualize them in User Interfaces and workflow diagrams. Translate those ideas into actionable steps in an Agile Scrum technology focused work environment.
Support Microsoft cloud infrastructure support like Virtual Machines, Azure SQL, Azure SQL with SDE, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Apps and Functions.
Support the development of SharePoint Sites with custom JavaScript Code inside iFrames and PowerApps.
Write Python and JavaScript code for data management, QA/QC, and automation opportunities between GIS and Non-GIS applications as well as field mobile data collection apps.
Identify and implement permission management in Azure, SharePoint, and OneDrive.
Maintain and catalog field GPS and Mobile Data Collection equipment and protocol with a virtual Mobile Device Management system.
Work directly with the Technical Services Manager, and with other project managers and personnel to support business tasks like:
Assist in supporting the permitting of large-scale energy generation projects.
Preparation of figures for permits.
GIS analysis for above ground risk mitigation.
Technical report writing.
Data compilation and analysis for report writing, permit application preparation, and plant community mapping.
Identify published sources and downloading of spatial data in support of natural resources projects.
Set up, collect, download, and post-process GPS data from a wide range of sources.

Required Qualifications

B.A. or B.S in Geosciences, Geography, GIS, or similar field.
5+ years of experience in GIS applicable role that required GIS to be used more than 50% of the work week.
1+ year Azure Cloud experience.
Basic working knowledge of computer science and its application to Python, JavaScript, and git repo management.
A pre-employment drug screen in compliance with state regulations is required.
Must possess a valid Driver's License with a clean driving record without restrictions.

Preferred Qualifications

Masters Degree in GIS.
Geographer or Equivalent.
10+ years experience.
Proposal Support.

Work Environment / Environmental Factors

Fully Remote – Visits required to Tetra Tech offices in Buffalo, Pittsburgh, Houston, etc.

Life At Tetra Tech

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
Merit-based financial rewards.
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

Job Title

Data Analyst – Curriculum

Secret Clearance Required To Be Qualified For This Role.

Location

This position is at Naval Education and Training Command (NETC) on-board Naval Air Station (NAS) Pensacola, FL.

Target salary range: $68,000 - $72,000
. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Objective

The Data Analyst
advises on the potential benefits/uses of automation to improve the efficiency of program operations; Analyzes a variety of data sources to provide data-driven insights to the organization to streamline processes; Analyzes and evaluates (on a quantitative and/or qualitative basis) the effectiveness of line program operations in meeting established goals and objectives; Analyzes and evaluates the effectiveness of organization based on data findings to improve operations; Analyzes management information requirements to develop program or administrative reporting systems including the systems specifications, data gathering and analytical techniques, and systems evaluation methodology.

Job Description

Perform work requirements to meet standard formatting, high-quality products, and submission timelines.
Perform comparative analysis of multiple data sheets/data sources concurrently daily and provide reports on data discrepancies, abnormalities, deltas, and overall data integrity.
Perform impact analysis on business requirements/processes to ensure alignment with the mission and training systems.
Working within NETC N73 branch, provide guidance to NETC learning centers with Interactive Multimedia Instruction (IMI) content in troubleshooting, creating, and assisting with their eLearning content development.
Validate curriculum data across Navy systems to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
Create and deliver written reports, visualizations, dashboards, or data models based on data collected and analyzed using various tools such as MS Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Power Apps, Power BI, and SharePoint Online (SPO).
Provide periodic user training for NETC training systems.
Collect, categorize, and analyze data.
Use data visualization software and other data tools to present findings.
Provide business recommendations to stakeholders based on data analysis.
Additional duties as assigned.

Employment Status

Full-time (40 hours per week). Salaried. Exempt.

Qualifications

2 years’ experience in database maintenance and development in education or training environments.
Knowledge in developing and utilizing the Power Apps suite to design and implement custom workflows and dashboards to include task automation, multi-step approvals, data validation, and real-time reporting, with integration capabilities across tools such as SPO, Power BI, and Power Automate to drive efficiency, enhance collaboration, and support scalable solutions.
Knowledge of and work with, on a daily/regular basis, NETC training systems and curriculum data development systems.
Proficient in Microsoft Office software.
Written and oral communication skills.
Ability to read, interpret, organize, and synthesize source material into well-written, concise learning products.
Ability to evaluate complex and disparate data sources, documents, and operational artifacts to derive actionable insights. Analyzes, synthesizes, and extrapolates knowledge to inform decision-making, identify trends, and propose innovative solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

Work Environment and Travel

This position is at Naval Education and Training Command (NETC) on Naval Air Station (NAS) Pensacola, FL. Qualified candidates should be local to Pensacola, FL, or surrounding areas to be considered for this position.
Ability to lift items and/or equipment up to 50 lbs. on limited occasions.
Travel up to 10% anticipated.

Description

Company Vision & Position Summary

Our vision is to create an environment where individuals are not only eager to succeed but also prepared and supported to thrive. We are dedicated to fostering growth that extends beyond our organization, enriching the lives of our people, their families and the communities they serve. At Maxair, we strive to cultivate a workplace where individuals find fulfillment in their work and build meaningful connections with each other.

Core Values

At Maxair, our Core Values guide how we work, support one another, and make decisions throughout the organization:

ACCOUNTABILITY: Willingness to take ownership of my own actions and encouraging others to do the same, fostering a culture of responsibility and growth.
DRIVE: The unwavering determination to support those around you, overcome obstacles, and achieve goals.
HUMILITY: Having an accurate assessment of your abilities and putting the interest of the team ahead of your own.
INTEGRITY: Always doing the right thing—even when it isn’t convenient, or no one is watching.
PEOPLE FOCUSED: Prioritizing the well-being and growth of teams, families, customers, and the community, ensuring they feel connected, supported, and valued.

Position Purpose

The Project Coordinator is responsible for leading the day-to-day execution of assigned Sheet Metal construction projects while developing people, supporting customers, and driving operational excellence. Success in this role requires balancing manpower, schedules, budgets, customer expectations, and field operations while making sound decisions that support both project success and Maxair's long-term goals.

This position works closely with Project Managers, Project Executives, Field Leaders, customers, vendors, unions, and internal support teams to remove obstacles, develop employees, improve processes, and ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and profitably.

What Success Looks Like

Keep projects properly staffed, scheduled, and supplied so crews remain productive.
Lead and support Sheet Metal Foremen while creating a culture of accountability, safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
Build strong working relationships with PMs, field leaders, office staff, vendors, customers, and union representatives.
Make timely, sound decisions that keep projects moving while protecting profitability.
Deliver a positive customer experience while protecting Maxair's interests.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

Plan, organize, and coordinate labor, materials, equipment, fabrication, and subcontractors.
Develop manpower plans that align project schedules, workforce capabilities, and customer commitments.
Evaluate vendor and subcontractor proposals for compliance, quality, schedule, and value.
Coordinate internal fabrication, warehouse deliveries, and field logistics.
Create and maintain SIP documentation and project completion lists to support project execution.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and support Sheet Metal Foremen by setting clear expectations and providing timely feedback.
Participate in employee performance reviews and workforce development.
Enforce company safety policies and promote a culture of accountability.

Customer & Business Leadership

Build trust with customers through proactive communication and timely issue resolution.
Work collaboratively with Project Managers, Project Executives, and support departments.
Manage labor, purchase orders, receipts, fleet compliance, and field needs.
Support corporate goals, mission, vision, and relationships with Local Union 85.

Qualifications

10+ years commercial HVAC installation experience.
Local Union 85 Sheet Metal Foreman.
Knowledge of HVAC systems, codes, and construction methods.
Ability to read plans and specifications.
Strong communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.
OSHA 30 Certification and valid driver's license.
Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook, and job cost software.

Leadership Expectations

Successful Project Coordinators consistently demonstrate the ability to plan ahead, hold themselves and others accountable, collaborate across departments, make sound decisions under changing conditions, and build lasting customer relationships. These behaviors are essential to long-term success in this role and reflect Maxair's Core Values every day.

General Notes

Who We Are

We are “the power behind UT”.

Utilities and Energy Management (UEM) provides reliable and cost-effective electricity, chilled water, steam, deionized water, compressed air, emergency power, and elevator services for The University of Texas at Austin. We have more than 170 employees in five divisions: Utilities Operations; Utilities Distribution; Power Systems, Controls, and Operating Technology; Finance and Administrative Services; and Engineering and Technical Services.

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking candidates who share the following core values:

Safety: Commitment to the well-being of our fellow employees, ourselves, and the campus community.

Respect: Treating everyone with fairness and dignity.

Integrity: Transparency, honesty, trust and ethics in our work and our relationships.

Reliability: Delivery of consistent, dependable, and uninterrupted services.

Teamwork: Working together through cooperation, contribution, and the sharing of our knowledge.

Excellence: Setting the highest standards through innovation, collaboration, forward-thinking, and stewardship.

As a member of our team, you will be part of a globally recognized district energy system that serves a top-tier research university. We strive to provide a positive workplace culture that welcomes ideas, talent and perspectives – and we look forward to hearing from you!

Competitive health benefits (employee premiums covered at 100%, family premiums at 50%)
Voluntary Vision, Dental, Life, and Disability insurance options
Generous paid vacation, sick time, and holidays

Robust free training access through LinkedIn Learning plus professional conference opportunities.

Purpose

Program Coordinator or Program Specialist provides operational, administrative, and coordination support across three key organizational programs—UT Works, Safety, and Career Development.

Program Coordinator provides coordinated administrative and operational support with a focus on assisting program logistics, documentation, training coordination, and communication while developing working knowledge of UEM programs, systems, and processes. The position works under general direction and supports program staff and stakeholders to ensure programs run

smoothly and consistently.

Program Specialist supports planning, execution, and continuous improvement with a focus on coordinating program activities, supporting system and process implementation, engaging with stakeholders across the organization, and ensuring accurate documentation, training coordination, and communication. The position operates with a higher level of independence, applies programmatic and technical judgment, and contributes to development and refinement of program standards, workflows, and resources.

Program Planning & Execution: Coordinate and support planning, scheduling, and logistics for UT Works, Safety, and Career Development program activities. Manage day‑to‑day program activities, schedules, documentation, and deliverables to ensure programs are implemented effectively and consistently across the organization. Provide team with project management support for implementing programs and projects, e.g., schedule and coordinate project meetings, create agendas, attend meetings, take notes, and compile and share meeting recaps/minutes. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication: Serve as a program liaison with UEM divisions, supervisors, training partners, and program participants. Communicate program requirements, timelines, and updates; respond to inquiries; and ensure stakeholders have accurate, timely information to support successful participation and adoption. Maintain and update program communications (email, web pages, user guides, etc.)
Training Support: Coordinate and support training activities across UT Works, Safety, and Career Development programs. Manage logistics for in‑person and virtual sessions, track participation and completion, support instructors and facilitators, and assist with development and maintenance of training materials and guidance resources. Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

Responsibilities

Job Overview

Project Tracking & Velocity

Update and maintain real-time project schedules, task lists, milestone trackers, and action item logs across multiple security workstreams using designated project management software (e.g., Asana).
Track cross-functional project dependencies, monitor progress timelines, and maintain team RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) to proactively flag at-risk milestones to the Project Manager.
Update project dashboards and reporting tools with current operational data, leveraging project management software and basic data visualization tools to provide ongoing visibility into pipeline health.
Monitor outstanding project deliverables and follow up with tactical stakeholders to ensure project tasks are completed within agreed-upon timelines.

Meeting Coordination & Administration

Coordinate schedules and logistics for project meetings, working group sessions, and project milestone reviews under the direction of team leadership.
Prepare detailed meeting agendas, capture clear meeting minutes, and document critical action items (AIs) and decision logs for timely distribution to project stakeholders.
Provide administrative support for the team’s centralized intake pipeline, assisting with the initial organization of incoming project requests.

Documentation Governance & Audit Readiness

Maintain project documentation, change records, and deviation reports in organized, controlled, and easily accessible enterprise repositories (e.g., Google Workspace, team portals).
Ensure ongoing project artifacts, meeting minutes, and compliance deliverables are continuously validated, complete, and structured to satisfy internal and external regulatory audit requirements.
Assist in collecting, compiling, and organizing raw project metrics and performance data to support the preparation of Monthly Readouts and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
Provide formatting and compilation support for project briefings, slide decks, and status reports to ensure alignment with organizational standards and branding parameters.

Minimum Qualifications

3–5 years of professional experience in project coordination or administrative project support roles, preferably within corporate security, operations, or highly matrixed technology environments.
Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise project management tracking systems (e.g., Asana, Smartsheet, Jira) and collaboration suites (e.g., Google Workspace, MS Office).
Proven track record of successfully maintaining complex project schedules, logging task updates, and tracking cross-functional project dependencies to preserve milestone velocity.
Strong experience orchestrating meeting logistics, developing structured agendas, and rapidly capturing high-quality, actionable meeting minutes and RAID log items.
Capability to organize raw data, track performance metrics, and consistently update status-reporting frameworks or progress dashboards.
Experience working successfully within a managed service, consulting, or staff augmentation model.
Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Management) certification or completed academic coursework in formal project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall).
Foundational familiarity with corporate security concepts, governance terminology, or compliance workflows.
Practical exposure to data visualization or dashboard maintenance tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio/Google Data Studio).

Why M Physicians?

The NAVIGATE program
at M Physicians is affiliated with the University of Minnesota Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences, a leader in first episode psychosis care and research. The NAVIGATE program started in 2017 with the support of grant funds from the Minnesota Department of Human Services. NAVIGATE is an evidence-based coordinated specialty care program to treat first episode psychosis in schizophrenia spectrum disorders. This interdisciplinary team-based approach is resiliency- and recovery-focused. Team members work with individuals ages 15 to 40 years old, and their natural support persons, to help them understand their illness and develop skills that help them get back on track and live rich and meaningful lives. Why M Physicians?

The NAVIGATE program
at M Physicians is affiliated with the University of Minnesota Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences, a leader in first episode psychosis care and research. The NAVIGATE program started in 2017 with the support of grant funds from the Minnesota Department of Human Services. NAVIGATE is an evidence-based coordinated specialty care program to treat first episode psychosis in schizophrenia spectrum disorders. This interdisciplinary team-based approach is resiliency- and recovery-focused. Team members work with individuals ages 15 to 40 years old, and their natural support persons, to help them understand their illness and develop skills that help them get back on track and live rich and meaningful lives. NAVIGATE involves a number of different interventions including medication management, individual resiliency training (IRT), help getting back to work or school (Supported Employment and Education or SEE), peer support, case management and care coordination, and family support and education. NAVIGATE team members are highly skilled at providing both clinical and non-clinical support and services to individuals and families impacted by a first episode of psychosis, whether that be in the clinic, community, or an individual's home. Team members are highly collaborative, attend weekly team meetings to discuss patient care, and receive one-to-one supervision from the program’s director.
